lines.text: In this lesson, you will learn to use a repeat block to do the same moves many times and make code shorter.
The repeat block does the blocks inside it again and again.
The number on the repeat block says how many times.
Stairs go right, up, right, up.
A repeat makes long code short.
Go right 6 squares. The arrow can only move 1, so use 🔁 repeat!
Repeat 6 times: move right. Two blocks instead of six!
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now build along, then try the challenges. You’ve got this!
